notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Switched the engine to an older version that supports Windows 7 and Windows 8.1.
[*] This should fix the "Corrupt download" issue some users encountered on older systems.
[/olist]

[b]Note: This change will unfortunately make previous save files incompatible. I apologize for the inconvenience. If this affects you, I strongly recommend using the fast forward or skip option in the game to quickly return to your previous progress.[/b]

notes.title: Oceanlust: Erotic Descent is almost here! Launching May 9th, 2025!
notes.content:
The wait is almost over. Oceanlust: Erotic Descent officially launches on May 9th, 2025 on Steam!

You've somehow won a very shady contest and now you're stuck in a submarine with a hot, sarcastic guide exploring a legendary shipwreck. What could possibly go wrong? A lot. In all the best ways!

Expect sexy tension, snappy dialogue, ridiculous choices and a story that’s fully aware of how absurd it all is.
Add it to your wishlist so you don’t miss the plunge!
